contents.role: The pattern, taught end to end for an agent reader: the verify pass steps, step-zero handle discipline, the verdict vocabulary used exactly, what a receipt does and does not prove.
Agent-facing entry point: what this package makes you able to do and the 5-minute path from reading to a recorded verdict.

Runnable verifier (standard library only): takes a receipt id or /run/ link, calls the v2 verify endpoint, prints checks and verification_status, compares an optional claim against the saved record, and walks a handover's steps verifying each.
No-code standing instructions for a verifier chat agent.
Proof: the record of a real two-agent run on the live endpoint (2026-11-02), in which the pass returned verified for a true retelling and mismatch for a deliberately wrong one, every link live.

description: Agent package: learn the verify pass from the skill inside, then check any agent's work against its own record on Zambo. Take a claim plus its receipt link, check the receipt at the v2 verify endpoint, compare the claim against what was actually saved, and record the verdict as a receipted step. Trust the record, not the retelling.
free_tier: Per agent, keyed to its own caller handle: 20 calls + 1 wrap-up free every day; picking up a handover is always free; reading the verify endpoint costs no quota. Day Pass $0.99 per agent, unlimited 24 hours. Zambo Pass $29 per agent, 30 days. One-time payments, never subscriptions.
name: zambo-verify-pass
positioning: Zambo is the verifiable work layer for AI: every call returns a verifiable receipt. This package teaches the checking side of that record. It does not judge whether the work was the right work; it checks fidelity between a claim, a receipt, and the saved record.
